messages.content: "comparison trap" social media te kivabe kaj kore ar eta theke ber hoyar kono practical way ache?

Comparison trap shuru hoy karon amra sobsomoy onno der highlight reel dekhi, tader behind-the-scenes struggle na. Ekta perfectly edited photo dekhe amra assume kori oder life ta oi rokom e perfect, jeta almost kokhono sotti hoy na.

Eta ber howar kichu practical way ache. Prothomoto, notice koro kokhon scroll korার somoy negative feeling ashe - specific account gulo mute ba unfollow koro jara consistently oi feeling create kore. Dwitiyoto, nijer growth track koro time ke, onno kauke na - last mash er nijer theke aj kotota better acho seta compare koro.

Ar sobcheye important, mone rakho social media ekta highlight reel, full picture na. Jara sobcheye "perfect" dekhay, tader o নিজের struggle ache je tumi dekhcho na simply.
